currentBehavior.description: The ChatClarification component cycles through all SMART components sequentially regardless of confidence scores
problemAreas: No prioritization based on confidence scores
Moves to next component after each response
Doesn't check if current component needs more refinement
All components are processed even if they have high confidence

desiredBehavior.description: Prioritize low-scoring components and refine until 90%+ confidence
requirements: Focus on the lowest scoring aspects first
Keep clarifying that aspect until it reaches 90%+
Don't cycle through all aspects if they don't need clarification

keyChanges: Replace componentIndex with dynamic component selection based on confidence
Add getNextComponent() function to find lowest confidence component < 90%
Modify handleSendMessage to check confidence after each response

implementationSteps.description: Create function to get components sorted by confidence
implementationSteps.code: const getComponentsByConfidence = () => SMART_COMPONENTS.filter(c => goal.criteria[c.key].confidence < 0.9).sort((a, b) => goal.criteria[a.key].confidence - goal.criteria[b.key].confidence)
